name: Anastasis Giakoumatos
tagline: Bringing AI closer to mobile apps, with banking-grade reliability
intro: Mobile Engineer specializing in Android, based in Athens, Greece. I bring AI closer to mobile apps: turning models into features people actually use on their phones, built to the same standard as the apps that handle their money. For 7 years I've shipped mobile banking, payments and iGaming apps used by millions, where reliability is non-negotiable. In my own apps I build AI-powered features like natural-language voice entry with GPT, and in production teams I use AI tools to ship faster without lowering the bar. I work in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose every day, lead modularization efforts and mentor developers.
